column1: R4-SEM-01|Q-1019 TD-1017|STRONG_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Compose a robot's request for time to think without being rushed. Chess/lunch are different wrappers; TD truth and Q ask the same pause-request operation, while TD dare adds comic food imagery.

R4-SEM-02|TD-1018 TD-1067 TD-1020|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Write clock/alarm wording for quiet/rest. TD1018 explicitly asks permission and accepts later; TD1067 requests quiet mode; TD1020 announces a tournament break. The speech-act direction differs, so this is a conservative review concern, not established identity.

R4-SEM-03|Q-1079 TD-1076 YB-1076 YB-1119|STRONG_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Invent recurring friends' funny habit/tradition. Moving bridges, sun-following houses and flying stairs change the scenery; TD truth and YB1119 preserve the ritual operation without that scenery. Public/private variants are linked explicitly.

R4-SEM-04|Q-1125 YB-1124 TD-1084|STRONG_PLUS_PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Q1125 and YB1124 compose a closing/farewell at a fairy meeting; YB adds a wish. TD1084 dare composes a final adventure line rather than necessarily goodbye, a weaker related closing concern explicitly needing disposition.

R4-SEM-05|TD-1159 YB-1172|STRONG_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Write a dialogue/note between one's fictional curiosity and caution. Discovery versus open reply changes the continuation, not the central two-sided self-portrait operation.

R4-SEM-06|Q-1117 TD-1117|STRONG_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Compare preferred form of an invitation to a shared creative idea/draft. TD adds invitation-writing for a drawing collection; optional draft and one/many-plan framing are differences within the same preference operation.

R4-SEM-07|Q-1116 TD-1143 YB-1086|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Choose/help express question or suggestion versus independent thinking. Q and TD truth contrast support forms; YB owl/cat specifically defers advice. Cat/owl roleplay does not erase the advice-autonomy overlap, but is not automatically equivalent to a personal preference.

R4-SEM-08|TD-1119 YB-1120 TD-1158 YB-1157|STRONG_PLUS_PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|TD1119 and YB1120 repeat fairy guest choosing watching versus performing magic. TD1158 moves observation choice to a parade; YB1157 designs observer viewpoints rather than making the choice, a weaker related concern rather than blanket topic equivalence.

R4-SEM-09|Q-1162 TD-1156 TD-1161 TD-1166 TD-1167 YB-1154|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Choose how much meaning/detail of an imagined object to reveal or preserve. Medal/souvenir/charm/accessory/exhibition/box give distinct artefacts and some distinct operations (meaning privacy versus pleasant unknown); retain as an explicit disclosure-operation review cluster, not all objects grouped as repeats.

R4-SEM-10|Q-1154 TD-1155 YB-1165 TD-1183|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Imagine a place/object condition enabling unhurried pace: hotel time cue, café detail, slowly chosen object or no-hurry island. Choice/design/recognition operations differ; review this specific autonomy-and-environment overlap without declaring all pace cards identical.

R4-SEM-11|YB-1168 YB-1171|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Create personal verbal portraits using pace and pauses. Morning with space/pace versus two self-portraits changes output; a specific self-portrait operation overlap remains, not all personal routine topics.

R4-SEM-12|Q-1110 YB-1107|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Choose musical images for a visual card/drawing. Friendly postcard versus combined calm-evening drawing changes social outcome and coauthoring; both still translate musical preference into image.

R4-SEM-13|TD-1106 YB-1108|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Quiet musical opening wording versus immediate-theme/intro preference. TD dare specifically describes the opening; TD truth changes tempo/timbre. Family is based on the overlapping side, not falsely treating all TD sides as identical.

R4-SEM-14|Q-1044 Q-1176|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Choose an album/collection cover. Q1044 requires instrumental-music cover; Q1176 chooses blank/repeated-symbol design of unspecified album. Medium/constraint differ and music ambiguity stays open.

R4-SEM-15|Q-1054 YB-1179|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Explain an umbrella's unusual relationship with weather: sunny holiday versus opening after rain. Different comic causality remains; flag a concrete cross-visibility premise overlap, not assume exact duplicate.

R4-SEM-16|Q-1033 TD-1160|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Express personal mood/pleasure through dessert/cake. Mood symbol versus ordering/description of mood layers differs; overlapping food-as-self-image operation warrants review, not automatic exclusion of all food.

R4-SEM-17|Q-1168 YB-1161|PARTIAL_OPERATION_OVERLAP|Identify a detail/freedom making a visitor comfortable in another's home. Own familiar-person visit versus wholly fictional first-two-minutes scene differs; central visitor-settling operation overlaps without requiring personal disclosure.
